description: Corrections for OpenStax 'Introduction to Intellectual Property' (CC BY 4.0), PDF of 201 pages. Titles and pages are as printed by `tocleaf analyze`; pages are 1-based. Each rule removes one outline entry and everything nested under it. Rules are curation choices, not repairs: delete a rule to restore the entry.

exclude.title: Contents
exclude.reason: Front matter: the printed table of contents. Its text repeats the ToC rather than describing the book's subject matter.

exclude.title: Preface and Foreword
exclude.reason: Front matter about the publisher and the book's origin, not its subject matter. Also removes its nested entry 'About OpenStax'.

exclude.title: Chapter Outline
exclude.reason: Chapter 1 list of sections. Unnumbered in the outline, so it conflicts with the printed section numbers, and it has no explanatory text.

Odd-page running head: section number, bullet, section title and page number. Not section content.
